erpImport.title: Import from the ERP
erpImport.intro: Type a style code: every SKU of that style comes in from the ERP as one draft product, with its colour, size, barcode and buying price. You set the selling price on the product page.

state.practice: The practice ERP is running: you can preview a style, but nothing is saved as real products.
state.none: This store runs without an ERP, so there is nothing to import.
state.unavailable: The ERP connection does not work right now.

model.v5: The ERP connection still uses the old contract (v5): buying prices come once the ERP model is v6.
model.v6: The ERP sells to the shop at its shop price (v6).

erpImport.practice: Practice ERP: this preview is sample data. Nothing is saved.

form.label: Style code
form.help: The style code is the ERP's code for one design; all its colours and sizes come together.

preview.title: What comes in: {style}
preview.missingColours: These colours are not in your colour list yet; add them first: {list}
preview.noSelling: No selling price is set here, and customers never see the buying price.
preview.v5: Import by style code works only once this store is on the new ERP contract (v6). Until then products come as before.
preview.adopt: into “{name}”, made before the ERP: it gets this style code ({n} SKUs)
preview.conflicts: These SKUs already sit in other products, so nothing is imported. Move or archive them first, then look the style up again:
preview.invalid: The shop cannot take these rows as the ERP sent them, so nothing is imported. Fix them in the ERP first:

skip.ARCHIVED: Archived in the shop (restore it on the product page first)

invalid.SIZE: the size name is too long
invalid.GARMENT_CHANGED: the SKU already exists here with another colour or size

erpImport.noWrite: Making the draft needs the permission to change products.
erpImport.noPrices: Buying prices are shown only to people with the prices permission.

changes.title: Buying price changed
changes.intro: The ERP changed what it sells these {n} pieces to the shop for. Your selling price has not changed: check it.

stock.title: Stock and ERP sync
stock.intro: Stock comes from the ERP. Here you see when it last came in, what failed and what is still waiting to go to the ERP.
stock.noSync: Re-sync and the ERP check need the "run stock sync" permission.

ok.title: All in order
ok.text: Stock is coming in from the ERP on time and nothing is stuck.

practice.title: Practice ERP
practice.text: The ERP keys are not in yet, so the shop practises against a pretend ERP. Real stock is not touched.

late.title: Stock is late
late.text: No stock update for more than {minutes} minutes. The shop keeps selling from its last copy.

failing.title: Something failed
failing.text: The last stock update or a document to the ERP failed. See the list below.

down.title: The ERP cannot be reached
down.text: The ERP connection does not work, or documents gave up after every try. Nothing is lost: they wait here.

off.title: No ERP
off.text: This store runs without an ERP, so there is nothing to sync.

erp.title: ERP connection
erp.sub: The ERP is the master of stock. The shop only reads it.
erp.resuming: The last update stopped half way; the next one carries on from there.
erp.events: ERP events that need a look
erp.eventsText: {failed} could not be read or applied · {changed} came again with different content. Nothing was applied from them.

resync.skuLabel: SKU of one product to re-sync
resync.failed: The ERP did not answer ({code}). The shop keeps its last copy.
resync.notInErp: The ERP has no stock for {sku}.

skipped.ERP_ON_PRACTICE: Practice ERP: nothing to re-sync until the real keys are in.
skipped.ERP_NONE: This store runs without an ERP.

reconcile.button: Check all stock against the ERP
reconcile.found: {n} differences found ({ok} rows match). Nothing was changed: re-sync fixes them.
reconcile.partial: The check stopped at the page limit; run it again for the rest.
reconcile.unknown: {n} ERP rows are for styles the shop does not have yet.
reconcile.failed: The check could not finish ({code}). Nothing was changed.

skipped.ERP_ON_PRACTICE: Practice ERP: there is nothing real to check yet.
skipped.ERP_NONE: This store runs without an ERP.

docs.title: Documents to the ERP
docs.sub: Confirmed orders and their changes go to the ERP as documents. Each is sent once, even if it is tried again.

low.title: Low stock
low.sub: Counted once for all stores together, after what is held in checkout.

queue.title: Waiting to go live, with real stock
queue.sub: Products not on the shop yet, with the pieces the ERP has. The checklist runs again by itself when their stock changes.
queue.findStyles: Find new styles in the ERP
queue.practice: These are practice styles from the pretend ERP.
queue.stylesNone: This store runs without an ERP.
queue.stylesNoneNew: The shop already has every style the ERP sells.
queue.truncated: Only the first pages were read; there may be more.

runs.title: Recent runs
runs.sub: Each stock update, re-sync, check and sending round, newest first.

erpCodes.AUTH: The ERP refused the key. Check it on Keys & connections.
erpCodes.FORBIDDEN: The ERP does not allow this key to do that.
erpCodes.NOT_FOUND: The ERP does not know it.
erpCodes.CONFLICT: The ERP refused: not enough stock there.
erpCodes.RATE_LIMITED: The ERP asked to slow down; it is tried again later.
erpCodes.INVALID_REQUEST: The ERP refused the document as wrong.
erpCodes.SERVER: The ERP had an error; it is tried again later.
erpCodes.TIMEOUT: The ERP took too long to answer.
erpCodes.NETWORK: The ERP could not be reached.
erpCodes.BAD_RESPONSE: The ERP answered in a way the shop does not understand.
erpCodes.NOT_CONFIGURED: The ERP address or key is missing.
erpCodes.COMPANY_MISMATCH: The key belongs to another ERP company. Nothing was synced.
erpCodes.ERP_UNAVAILABLE: The ERP connection does not work.

errors.ERP_ON_PRACTICE: The practice ERP's data is only a preview; it is never saved as real products.
errors.COLOUR_MISSING: Add these colours to the colour list first: {fields}
errors.NOTHING_TO_IMPORT: The ERP has nothing of this style the shop can import.
errors.ERP_NOT_CONNECTED: This store runs without an ERP.
errors.ERP_UNAVAILABLE: The ERP connection does not work. Check Keys & connections.
errors.AUDIT_OPEN: This place is being counted already. Open that count instead.
errors.REASON_REQUIRED: Every line that differs needs a reason first.
errors.CONFLICT: This count is closed or not ready for that step.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Something is not filled in right: {fields}
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have the permission for this.
errors.ERP_V5: Import by style code works only once this store is on the new ERP contract (v6).
errors.SKU_IN_OTHER_PRODUCT: Some SKUs of this style already sit in other products: {fields}. Nothing was imported.
errors.ROW_NOT_ACCEPTED: The shop cannot take some rows as the ERP sent them: {fields}. Nothing was imported.

counts.title: Stock counts
counts.intro: Count a shelf or a room with the barcode scanner. The count only reports: the stock stays as the ERP says, and the differences go to the ERP team with their reasons.
counts.newSub: One place at a time; one open count per place.
counts.noLocations: No places yet. Add a warehouse first.
counts.unknownPlace: A place that is no longer listed

sub.COUNTING: Scan each piece, or type the SKU and the number. When the place is done, compare with the ERP.
sub.REVIEW: The ERP numbers are fixed now. A forgotten shelf can still be scanned. Each difference needs a reason.
sub.COMPLETED: The result is kept. The stock stays as the ERP says.
sub.CANCELLED: This count was stopped without a result. It is kept here.

count.qtyBad: Pieces must be a whole number from 1 to {max}.
count.unknown: {code} is not known; it is kept as its own line ({n}).
count.cancelConfirm: Stop this count without a result? It stays in the list.

moves.title: Stock movements
moves.intro: What came in and went out, per SKU and place, from the changes the ERP sent. A line is marked when its changes do not add up to the stock now.
moves.badRange: The start date must be before the end date.
moves.gap: The changes do not add up to the stock now ({now}). Re-sync this SKU.
moves.truncated: Only the first lines are shown; pick fewer days or one SKU.
